text: OVERDOSAGE Significant mortality was observed in mice at an intra‑venous dose of 855 mg/kg and in rats at an oral or sub‑cutaneous dose of approximately 2618 mg/kg. In the mice, convulsions and depression were observed. Hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis are not effective in removing clindamycin from the serum.
